title: Executive daily priorities - Jordan Patel - 2026-03-04
content:
Morning scratchpad - quick, ephemeral. Not for immediate distribution.

Top objectives (today)
- 1) Finalize Dedicated SLA language for enterprise customers. Review legal note + Andres edits. Need decision on uptime metric threshold (99.9 vs 99.95).
- 2) Block time to align infra + product on rollout plan for Private VPC pilot (Customer A). Confirm onboarding checklist and KMS flow.
- 3) Review perf regression flagged in canary (latency tail at seq len 1024). Get triage + mitigation plan.

Weekly focus (context)
- Close Dedicated pricing pilot with 2 customers -> convert to MRR.
- Ship 1.2 runtime kernel that reduces kv-cache cold start by ~20%.
- Improve Console tracing for model rollouts (less noise for ops).

Meetings / prep (today)
- 09:00 - Exec sync (15m)
  - one-line updates: Dedicated commit status; Private pilot readiness; any exec blockers.
- 10:30 - Legal + Product (Dedicated SLA wording)
  - ask: approve uptime SLO and credit calc. Bring precedent from cloud infra contracts (see linked confluence).
- 11:30 - Infra triage (canary latency)
  - goals: reproduce, identify root cause (kernel choice? packing/batching), decide rollback vs mitigation.
- 15:00 - Customer A onboarding touchpoint
  - agenda: network & KMS questions, deploy window, support escalation path.

Follow-ups / action items (owners)
- Andres: update SLA draft with both 99.9 and 99.95 options + credit formula by EOD.
- Priya: run extended canary with sequence-length skewed traffic; capture p95/p99 and flamegraphs. Due: today EOD.
- DevOps (Ben): verify VPC peering checklist for Customer A; confirm KMS key rotation steps. Due: 2026-03-06.
- Maya: finalize pilot onboarding timeline and send consolidated calendar invites. Due: today.

Open questions / decisions needed
- Is 99.95 SLO feasible without >2x cost for reserved capacity? Short calc needed.
- If canary regression persists after kernel tweak, do we fallback to previous model variant or pause canary? Impact: customer error rates.

Notes to self (scratch)
- Quick talking points for exec sync: "Pilot momentum; SLA options; visibility into canary regression and mitigation plan."
- Keep timeline visible in tracker (INF-3421).
- Remember to cc sales lead on SLA email thread.

Time blocks (today)
- 08:30-09:00: inbox + prep notes
- 09:00-09:20: exec sync + follow-ups
- 09:30-11:00: SLA review session + edits
- 11:30-13:00: infra triage (hands-on)
- 13:00-15:00: deep work (kernel PR review)
- 15:00-16:00: Customer A call
- 16:00-17:30: synthesize notes, update INF-3421, assign next steps

Misc quick links / refs
- CIR: INF-3421 (canary latency regression) - jira link above.
- SLA draft: confluence link above.
- Kernel PR: github link above.

End-of-day checklist
- Confirm Andres pushed SLA changes?
- Priya posted canary results?
- Update INF-3421 with current status and next actions.

Random scratch (brain dump)
- Consider offering 3-tier SLA (standard, pro, enterprise) to reduce negotiation friction. Pricing offsets with reserved capacity discounts.
- Add a short "what if" playbook for canary regressions to the runbook (ops).

---
Hand-off notes if OOO: leave this doc and mark items owned in tracker.
